Is this the start of a Tim Hortons comeback in the Philippines?

After months of branch closures across the country, Tim Hortons has reopened at least a single location—the one inside Centro Escolar University Manila—hinting at a possible turnaround in the brand’s local story.

The reopening comes after a wave of shutdowns that fueled speculation throughout 2025 about whether the coffee chain was quietly scaling back its Philippine presence. Branches in several major malls had closed one after another, leaving customers questioning the company’s long-term plans despite earlier assurances that it was staying in the market.

Now, the return of a campus-based store introduces a different narrative. Rather than a full exit, the move may suggest repositioning, downsizing, or a more targeted strategy focused on high-traffic communities such as universities.

Whether this marks the beginning of a broader comeback or simply an isolated reopening remains unclear. Still, the CEU return shows the brand is not entirely disappearing just yet.

Which Tim Hortons branch do you want to see reopen next?

Report by Kenneth M. del Rosario
